exact_statement: For every Boolean outer gate h on three uniform output inputs, every Boolean core g on three uniform physical bits, and two fresh uniform dictator cores, let F=h(g,y1,y2) with g substituted in any selected gate input. For each relevant coordinate i of g with Inf_i(F)>0, let C=H(F)-q H(g), where q is the pivotal probability of the selected gate input under the other two uniform outputs. The maximum over this entire finite domain of (average_b C(F|x_i=b)-C(F))/Inf_i(F) is exactly 3 log2(3)-4. All entropies use full squared Fourier spectra in bits. In particular a universal full-drift coefficient 1/2 is false.
